title: 第69章 我知道凶手是谁了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 这一猜测，瞬间让唐逸全身血液都沸腾了。　　如果猜测是真的，那这些所谓的练字帖，就是真正的账簿。　　顾城将朝中大臣从国库借走的银两的真正账簿，分散记录在了这些看似乱七八糟的练字帖中。　　若真是这样，不得不说顾城还真是个人才。　　唐逸将面前的一张宣纸放在腿上，拿起地上那本厚厚的书籍，书籍是《前朝史》，是记录大炎之前所有朝代大事件的史书。　　总字数足有二十万，是目前大炎字数最多的书籍之一。　　唐逸当即对照按照宣纸上的账目，找到相应的页数行数字数，然后再将字组合起来。　　就得到了一句话：　　我若死了，凶手是管家，证据在他房间床头的暗格。　　唐逸指尖猛地一颤，果然是密码。　　那这些账簿，就是真正的账簿！　　“嗯，是有点收获了。”　　唐逸站了起来，笑着扭了扭脖子。　　苏狂的笑声戛然而止。　　唰唰！　　所有人的目光，齐刷刷看向唐逸。　　全都面色错愕。　　有点收获？　　真的假的？　　这些账本和书籍，他们都快翻三百遍了，也没发现什么问题啊！　　“唐逸，真的有收获了？”　　萧澜美眸亮晶晶，立即跑到了唐逸的身侧，俏脸激动无比。　　“呵，有点收获？哈哈，宁川，真不愧是你一处的天才啊！”　　苏狂自然不信，嘲讽盯着宁川：“京都数百人账房高手都看不出问题，他居然两眼就能看出问题了，厉害，厉害极了！”　　“愣着干什么？此处应该有掌声。”　　“来，给一处的兄弟呱唧呱唧，恭喜他们找到新的线索。”　　啪啪啪！　　二处热烈的掌声和哄笑声震耳欲聋。　　宁川和一处众人脸色铁青，只觉得屈辱无比。　　“唐逸，真找到线索了？”宁川问道。　　唐逸摇头，道：“不是线索，是证据。”　　“而且凶手，我已经知道是谁了。”　　顷刻间，全场顿时一片死寂。　　所有人盯着唐逸，都是满脸震惊。　　他们查了这么多天，除了知道顾城是中毒死的外，其他没有任何头绪。　　唐逸在地上坐了一会儿，竟然就知道凶手是谁了？　　而且，证据都出来了？　　开什么玩笑！　　“菜鸟果然是菜鸟，哈哈哈……”　　“一处的天才，还真是名不虚传，牛逼啊！”　　“服了，一处果然有逆天大佬，不服都不行。”　　“……”　　二处刺耳的嘲笑声响彻整个书房。　　看得一处一群人都如坐针毡，唐逸你小子能靠谱点吗？　　今日要是不说出个所以然，咱一处就丢人丢到姥姥家了。　　就连萧棣，这时也都瞪着双眼盯着唐逸，有点难以置信。　　我这看了半天眼发晕，你看了一会儿就找出证据了？　　“笑什么笑，唐逸说这些是证据，这些就是证据。”　　“谁敢质疑，本宫让人剁碎喂狗！”　　萧澜气鼓鼓，很不满二处的人嘲笑唐逸。　　看着护犊子的萧澜，唐逸笑了笑将她拉到身后：“别那么激动，他们笑话嘲讽我，就是等我气急败坏说出真相呢。”　　“但是，我们没必要和他们解释。”　　萧澜美眸眨了眨，说得好像有理呀。　　孔诗岚嘴角微微扬起，她虽然不知道杀人凶手是谁，证据也乱七八糟的，但直觉告诉她，唐逸说的就是真的。　　二处一群人听到唐逸的话，人当时都麻了。　　特妈的，我们真没这个意思，我们是真的在嘲笑你。　　唯独苏狂嘴角的笑容渐渐收敛，心头莫名有些不安。　　他难道真知道了真凶是谁？　　我们查了这么久没头绪，就在那里翻两下，就知道真凶了？　　就在这时，唐逸的一句话，打消了他的所有怀疑。　　“宁头，让兄弟们将地上所有字帖，书籍，桌椅凳子，门窗全部带回北镇抚司。”　　“这些，可都是证据。”　　苏狂当时就笑出声，玩味盯着唐逸。　　“哈哈，这些全都是证据？”　　“你是要拿这些东西指证犯人？还是拿这些东西指证我们二处破坏证据？”　　“可笑，可笑！”　　唐逸同样满脸笑容，笑得挺开心，等案子真相揭开，有你们哭的时候。　　当然，他是不会现在揭开真相的。　　不然，舅舅的罪不白受了？　　先让二处构造好诬陷舅舅的证据，等他们势在必得的时候，再将他们从云端上……踹进地狱！　　“这没什么可笑的，苏千户，实话告诉你，这些的确都是证据，只是你们太蠢看不出来罢了。”　　唐逸将脚下的账簿，踹到苏狂的面前：“苏狂，我再给你一次机会，你不是要毁灭证据吗？现在一把火，将这一切全烧光。”　　“那所有罪证，就化为灰烬了。”　　苏狂听到唐逸这话，更确定唐逸是在虚张声势了。　　这是想要诱导他烧毁证据。　　他真敢众目睽睽之下一把火烧了书房，那就真是在销毁证据，就算他背后是太子，也保不住他。　　这就是他为什么敢将书房翻得一片狼藉，敢拆卸门窗，敢将屋内的书架书桌劈得粉碎，却不敢将书籍全部销毁。　　书桌书架可能在里面藏了东西，劈碎寻找说得过去。　　至于书里面有没有东西，甩一下就知道了，再一页一页的撕说是找证据，谁信？　　“呵呵，唐逸，你以为我会上你的当？”　　苏狂将脚下的账簿踢了回去，半点不在意：“你想要？全部都给你，我们二处不会和你们一处争这功劳。”　　“我们二处，丢不起这人。”　　二处众人也都起哄，嘲笑声跌宕起伏。　　唐逸却没有丝毫在意，摇了摇头道：“那太可惜了，苏狂，你是亲手将要你命的东西，送到我手上啊！”　　“我要不趁机让除掉你们，还真是天理难容。”　　唐逸看向宁川：“宁头，可以向陛下汇报了，就说已经查到了凶手是谁。”　　“只等陛下一声令下，随时可以将凶手缉拿归案。”　　宁川人都麻了。　　祖宗，你玩真的啊！　　直到现在我都不知道你是在装逼，还是认真的。　　不报陛下事情还有得缓，报了陛下，那事情就没得缓了。　　一旦玩砸了，那就是欺君之罪。　　那我们所有人都有可能掉脑袋。　　你是拿我们所有人的脑袋别在裤腰带上玩儿呢？
content_en: This guess instantly made Tang Yi's blood boil.If the guess is true, then these so-called calligraphy practice books are real account books.Gu Cheng scattered and recorded the real account books of the money borrowed by the ministers from the treasury in these seemingly messy calligraphy practice books.If this is the case, I have to say that Gu Cheng is really a talent.Tang Yi put a piece of rice paper in front of him on his lap and picked up the thick book on the ground. The book was "History of the Previous Dynasties", which was a history book that recorded all the major events of the dynasties before the Great Yan.The total number of words is 200,000, making it one of Dayan’s books with the most words.Tang Yi immediately compared the accounts on the rice paper, found the corresponding page number, row number, and then combined the words.Then I got a sentence: If I die, the murderer is the housekeeper, and the evidence is in the secret compartment beside the bed in his room.Tang Yi's fingertips trembled suddenly, and it turned out to be the password.Then these account books are the real account books!"Well, I gained something." Tang Yi stood up and twisted his neck with a smile.Su Kuang's laughter stopped abruptly.Swish!Everyone's eyes turned to Tang Yi.Everyone looked stunned.Got something gained?Real or fake?They have looked through these account books and books almost three hundred times, and they haven't found any problems!"Tang Yi, have you really gained something?" Xiao Lan's beautiful eyes sparkled and she immediately ran to Tang Yi's side, her pretty face extremely excited."Haha, something gained? Haha, Ning Chuan, you are truly a genius in your department!" Su Kuang naturally didn't believe it, and stared at Ning Chuan mockingly: "There are hundreds of accountants in Kyoto who can't see the problem, but he can actually tell it with just two eyesYou can see the problem.It's awesome!" "Why are you standing there?There should be applause." "Come on, congratulations to our brothers on finding new clues."The warm applause and laughter from both places were deafening.Ning Chuan and the people in one place were livid, feeling extremely humiliated."Tang Yi, did you really find a clue?" Ning Chuan asked.Tang Yi shook his head and said, "It's not a clue, it's evidence." "And I already know who the murderer is." In an instant, the whole place fell silent.Everyone stared at Tang Yi with shock on their faces.They had been investigating for so many days, but they had no clue except that Gu Cheng died of poisoning.After Tang Yi sat on the ground for a while, he actually knew who the murderer was?Moreover, the evidence has come out?What a joke!"The rookie is indeed a rookie, hahaha..." "The geniuses in the first department are really well-deserved, they are awesome!" "I'm convinced, there is indeed a big boss in the first department, I can't accept it." "..." The harsh ridicule from the second department resounded throughout the study.I can see a group of people sitting on pins and needles in one place, Tang Yi, can you be more reliable?If we don't tell you why today, we will be embarrassed and thrown into grandma's house.Even Xiao Di was staring at Tang Yi with wide eyes at this time, a little unbelievable.My eyes are dizzy after looking at it for a long time. You found the evidence after looking at it for a while?"Why are you laughing? Tang Yi said these are evidence, and these are evidence." "Who dares to question, I have people chop them into pieces and feed them to dogs!" Xiao Lan was very angry, and was very dissatisfied that the people in the second office laughed at Tang Yi.Looking at Xiao Lan who was protecting the calf, Tang Yi smiled and pulled her behind him: "Don't be so excited. They are just teasing me and waiting for me to get so angry that I tell the truth." "But we don't need to explain to them." Xiao Lan blinked her beautiful eyes, and it seemed to make sense.Kong Shilan raised the corners of her mouth slightly. Although she didn't know who the murderer was and the evidence was in a mess, her intuition told her that what Tang Yi said was true.When a group of people in the second office heard Tang Yi's words, they all went numb.Damn it, we really didn’t mean it, we were really laughing at you.Only Su Kuang's smile gradually faded, and he felt inexplicably uneasy.Did he really know who the real murderer was?We have been investigating for so long and have no clue. Just by looking through it twice, we will know the real murderer?At this moment, Tang Yi's words dispelled all his doubts."Ning Tou, ask the brothers to bring all the copybooks, books, tables, chairs, stools, doors and windows on the ground back to Beizhen Fusi." "These are all evidence." Su Kuang laughed out loud at that time and stared at Tang Yi playfully."Haha, these are all evidence?" "Are you going to use these things to accuse the prisoner? Or are you going to use these things to accuse us of destroying evidence?" "It's ridiculous, it's ridiculous!" Tang Yi was also smiling, smiling happily. When the truth of the case is revealed, you may cry.Of course, he will not reveal the truth now.Otherwise, my uncle’s sin will not be in vain?First, let the Second Division construct the evidence to frame your uncle, and then when they are sure to win, kick them from the clouds... into hell!"There's nothing funny about this, Su Qianhu, to tell you the truth, these are indeed evidence, but you are too stupid to see it." Tang Yi kicked the account book at his feet in front of Su Kuang: "Su Kuang, I will give it to you againDon't you want to destroy the evidence once you get a chance?Now use a fire to burn all the evidence." When Su Kuang heard what Tang Yi said, he was even more sure that Tang Yi was bluffing.This is to induce him to burn the evidence.If he really dares to burn down the study in front of everyone, he is really destroying evidence. Even if the prince is behind him, he can't be saved.This is why he dared to turn the study into a mess, dared to dismantle the doors and windows, and dared to smash the bookshelves and desks in the house, but he did not dare to destroy all the books.There may be something hidden in the desk and bookshelf. It makes sense to break it up and search for it.As for whether there is anything in the book, you can tell by flicking it around. If you tear it apart page by page and say it is to find evidence, who will believe it?"Haha, Tang Yi, do you think I will be fooled by you?" Su Kuang kicked back the account book at his feet, not caring at all: "You want it? I'll give it all to you. Our Second Office will not compete with your First Office for this credit." "Our Second Office cannot afford to lose this person." Everyone in the Second Office also booed, and the jeers rose and fell.Tang Yi didn't care at all, shook his head and said:
title_en: Chapter 69 I know who the murderer is!
